title: Silver Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Friends
summary: This document explains the Silver Rewards Card referral program: earn a $75 bonus for each successful referral, up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year. A referred friend must be approved and spend at least $750 within 60 days of account opening to qualify; bonuses typically post within 1–2 billing cycles after the $750 requirement is met.
